t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are several different coloured gnomes.  Take into account the different colours and the size of the hats.  There are different colours forests too.  If I pay attention I can get lots of mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Here is some advice to get the hang of the game:  There are pairs of gnomes that appear.  The pairs are always green & pink, red & yellow, blue & purple and orange & brown.When you select a gnome you are taken to a forest.  The orange, green, red and blue gnomes take you to a bright forest with a red basket.  The pink, yellow, brown and purple gnomes take you to a dark forest with a yellow basket.You press space bar to collect mushrooms.  There are different amounts of mushrooms each time, and it seems that the forest which gives the most mushrooms changes all the time too.I could not see any pattern with the size of the hats. I was told to try and always reach the forest which had the most mushrooms (which changes all the time).  I'm not sure my efforts were effective but that's what I tried to do. When you notice the number of mushrooms dropping, switch to the other forest.  Good luck!
